ChiSiamoOpeningText:
DeQua is a project of a group of Venetian friends born in late 2019.
We worked on it passionately during our free time, from Venice and the rest of the world, wherever we were.
ChiSiamoClosingText: For contact, write to info@dequa.it or look at Contacts.
HowitsMadeText: The process is as follows: we get the map of Venice and the Points of Interest from OSM, the addresses from the City of Venice, and we build a graph. In this graph there are thousands of nodes, linked together by arcs with features. For example, a house, a church or a bar are nodes. A calle or a canal are arcs. Now, the first step is to try to understand what the user is looking for. For that we use a search bar and a library (fuzzysearch) to find the match in our database. In case we have to create a map, we use a library (networkx) and describe the problem as finding the shortest path between two nodes in the graph. Having constructed the graph and being able to choose the shortest path definition, we have room to maneuver. For this we can calculate walking routes, paths with fewer bridges, rowing boat routes, motor boat routes, high water routes, and more.

FAQBirth_Q: How did DeQua come to life?
FAQBirth_A: DeQua was started by a group of Venetian friends with the intent to do something useful for the city. Initially we were just people who could program in Python with no graphics skills, then talking to a few people we found someone to help us and also teach us how to develop the frontend part and someone who had the will to redo all the graphics! The project came about after seeing that there is a lot of opensource city data, so we said, "Why not put all this data together and make a GoogleMaps that really works in Venice though?"
FAQWhatCanIDo_Q: What can I do with DeQua?
FAQWhatCanIDo_A: All the things you can do with a normal navigator or map app, with the only difference being that it is optimized for Venice! So you can search for an address, calculate a route simply from A to B or with stops in between, you can calculate the route on foot, by boat (rowing or motor), or by proving public transportation.  Also with DeQua you can calculate routes avoiding high water or optimized for people with motor difficulties.
FAQFree_Q: And all this would be free?
FAQFree_A: Yes, all of this is free! However, if you want to give us money write to us and we will arrange it!
FAQData_Q: Well but so it is free because you are using my personal information?
FAQData_A: No, it's just free. Google's services are free because they use all the information you give them, DeQua on the other hand is focused on privacy and we don't take any personal data from your searches. The only data we take is anonymous statistics about site usage, and we do this not to sell the information but just so we can understand how much it is used and what to do to improve it!
FAQCookie_Q: And why is there no annoying cookie warning?
FAQCookie_A: Because we don't take personal information! For traffic analysis we use Plausible which is a privacy-focused analytics software that does not collect any personal information!
FAQServer_A: All of our servers are in Europe!
